Name: perfect plan
Author: dickking123
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
This mod is a guide assistant to help you achieve Perfection in Stardew Valley! The function of this mod is to calculate and display the fish you still need to catch, the recipes you still need to cook, and the items you still need to craft before your save file reaches Perfection. It also displays the raw materials required for every unfinished recipe and crafted item, as well as the season, time, and weather in which each fish appears. At the same time, it can total up the names and quantities of all required raw materials and generate two separate summary tables for “Cooking Materials” and “Crafting Materials” (the cooking materials table excludes stored resources inside fridges, while the crafting materials table excludes all stored resources inside chests and the player inventory). Unearned recipes and blueprints will also be specially marked. All of these convenient features can be accessed simply by clicking a cute Junimo icon in the top-left corner of the game screen! To achieve Perfection, you no longer need to search guides across the entire internet, nor painfully write down the materials you need to prepare in memo pads only to always forget them. You only need to download this guide — come and try it out!

[b]Important Notes：[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Data Refresh:[/b] Please note that the mod's data sometimes requires you to exit to the title screen and re-load your save file to refresh.[/*]
[*][b]Feedback:[/b] If you encounter any bugs or issues with the data, feel free to leave a report and let me know![/*]
[/list][b]How to Use[/b]
[list=1]
[*][b]Open the Menu:[/b] After installing the mod, click the [b]blue Junimo icon[/b] in the top-left corner of your screen. This will display categories for uncaught fish, uncompleted recipes, and missing crafting blueprints.[/*]
[*][b]View Detailed Lists:[/b] Click on any of these three category headers to open its detailed list.[/*]
[*][b]Check Ingredients:[/b] Within the recipe or crafting lists, click on any item's name to view the exact raw materials required to make it. Click on a fish’s name to display the season, time, and weather in which that fish appears. [/*]
[*][b]Access the Summary Table:[/b] Return to the main menu page and look at the bottom—you will find the shortcut to the [b]All Materials Summary List[/b]. Click it to view a complete breakdown of every required material name and its total quantity.[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[b]Prerequisites:[/b]
[list]
[*]Make sure you have [b]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/b] installed.[/*]
[/list][b]How to Install:[/b]
[list=1]
[*][b]Download[/b] this mod.[/*]
[*][b]Extract[/b] the downloaded
[code].zip[/code]file.[/*]
[*][b]Copy[/b] the extracted folder.[/*]
[*][b]Paste[/b] the folder into your game's
[code]Mods[/code]directory (usually located at
[code]...\Stardew Valley\Mods[/code]).[/*]
[*][b]Launch[/b] the game using SMAPI to enjoy the mod![/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[*][b]Perfection Progress Tracking:[/b] Instantly calculates and displays the remaining fish to catch, recipes to cook, and items to craft needed to achieve Perfection.[/*]
[*][b]Detailed Ingredient Breakdown:[/b] Shows the exact raw materials required for each uncompleted cooking recipe and crafting item.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Material Summaries:[/b] Generates two separate summary tables for cooking and crafting materials, totaling the names and quantities of all required ingredients.[/*]
[*][b]Inventory & Storage Exclusion:[/b] Automatically excludes items you already own in your inventory, chests, and fridges from the material summaries, showing only what you actually need.[/*]
[*][b]Blueprint Status Display:[/b] Specially marks and highlights unearned or locked recipes and blueprints.[/*]
[*][b]One-Click Junimo Interface:[/b] Access all features effortlessly by clicking a cute Junimo icon located in the top-left corner of the game screen.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Make sure you have [b]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/b] installed.

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
"Huge thanks to Winnie for her incredible dedication and contribution to this mod! She implemented the essential feature that separates cooking and crafting materials and deducts existing stock from the total requirements. She also inspired the idea of graying out unearned recipes. Her impact on this project is truly immense!"

[/*]
